filter.nothing_customized: Nothing is customised — every setting is at the card default.
entity.accent_color_mode.helper: Home Assistant can hold a colour for each calendar, under Settings, Devices & Services, Entities. Calendars it has no colour for fall back to the card.
entity.event_type.helper: List the same calendar twice — once on each of the last two — to give its all-day and timed events different colours.
filter_duplicates.helper: Hides an event whose title, start, end and location all match another. The copy from the entry listed first is the one kept, along with its colour.
duplicate_accent_color.helper: Accent colour for an event kept from two or more different calendars, in place of the first calendar’s. Left empty it keeps that calendar’s colour.
weekend_background_color.helper: Tints the whole of a weekend day, so a week reads at a glance. Any CSS colour — keep it faint, since event text sits on top of it.
accent_color_mode.helper: Home Assistant can hold a colour for each calendar, under Settings, Devices & Services, Entities. Calendars it has no colour for keep the card default.
accent_color_mode.option.custom.label: Custom colour
event_background_opacity.helper: Tints each event with its accent colour. Zero leaves it untinted.
allday_badge_position.helper: Marks all-day events with a rounded badge in the calendar accent colour. On the time row it replaces the all-day label; on the title it wraps the event name. A title badge is kept to one line and shortened with an ellipsis where it does not fit.
allday_badge_style.helper: How much weight the badge carries, from a quiet wash to a solid block of colour.
allday_badge_color_mode.helper: Which colour the badge is drawn in. The accent gives every calendar its own; the row text colour gives them all the colour they already sit in, which is the time colour on the time row and the title colour on the title.
